nodes.name: Workspace owners and admins can now create API keys under…
nodes.text: Workspace owners and admins can now create API keys under **Workspace settings → API keys**. Keys are for product integrations—your sites, apps and services—not for agents.

nodes.name: A **public** key reads only published Grid content. It can…
nodes.text: A **public** key reads only published Grid content. It can be included in browser and mobile apps and viewed again later. A **private** key is shown once, stored by NullDull only as a hash, and belongs on a server. A private key can also be given read-only Memory access, acting as the member who created it within that member’s current access.

nodes.name: Keys can’t write, read Secrets, reach private Grid drafts…
nodes.text: Keys can’t write, read Secrets, reach private Grid drafts or manage anything. Rotation and revocation take effect on the next request.

nodes.name: Published Grid reads now use keys.
nodes.text: ## Published Grid reads now use keys.

nodes.name: From the same date, the production public Grid API…
nodes.text: From the same date, the production public Grid API requires a workspace API key with the Published Grid content scope. Invalid or revoked keys are rejected rather than treated as anonymous readers. The NullDull website reads its own pages this way.
